title: Implement Lagrange fractional delay with clamps and smooth bend read heads
description:
Create Source/DSP/FractionalDelay.h and Source/DSP/FractionalDelay.cpp implementing a single-channel fractional delay line with multiple read heads.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt (to see the existing target and source layout; do NOT modify it in this task)
- Source/DSP/ (existing DSP module style, include guards, namespace)
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (only to match naming/namespace conventions)

Required implementation (restate these numbers exactly in code):
1. Interpolation: third-order (4-point) Lagrange interpolation for fractional position mu in [0,1) with coefficients, verbatim:
   L_minus1 = -mu*(mu-1)*(mu-2)/6
   L_0      =  (mu+1)*(mu-1)*(mu-2)/2
   L_1      = -(mu+1)*mu*(mu-2)/2
   L_2      =  (mu+1)*mu*(mu-1)/6
   The interpolated sample is L_minus1*x[i-1] + L_0*x[i] + L_1*x[i+1] + L_2*x[i+2] using the delay-line indexing convention documented in the header.
2. Buffer sizing: prepare(double sampleRate, int maxBlockSize) allocates a circular buffer of ceil(8.25 * sampleRate) + 4 guard samples. This is the ONLY place memory is allocated. No allocation, resizing, locking, file IO, string construction, or exceptions in any per-sample or per-block processing function.
3. Clamping: every final read position, after modulation and offsets, is clamped to [8.0 samples, 8.25 * sampleRate samples]. Provide a private clampReadPosition(double) used by every read path; no read path may bypass it.
4. Read heads: support at least two simultaneous read heads so Smooth transitions can be rendered.
5. Smooth mode (no intentional pitch bend): two read heads r_old at D_old and r_new at D_new combined by equal-power crossfade
   r = cos(pi*lambda/2)*r_old + sin(pi*lambda/2)*r_new
   with lambda ramping linearly 0 -> 1 over the glide time. Glide time range is 5 ms to 1000 ms, clamped. When lambda reaches 1 the old head is retired.
6. Bend mode (intentional pitch bend): one read position ramped D[n] = D_start + lambda[n]*(D_target - D_start), with playback-rate factor p(t) = 1 - dD/dt so that decreasing delay raises pitch. Bend is exempt from any modulation pitch cap; document this in a comment.
7. Bounded modulation: setModulationOffsetSamples(double) accepts a signed offset that is bounded to a documented maximum before being added to the base read position; the result still passes through clampReadPosition.
8. reset() deterministically zeroes the buffer and all head state without reallocating.

The file must be standard C++20 only: include <cmath>, <vector>, <cstdint>, <algorithm> as needed. Do NOT include any JUCE header in these two files; this keeps the module independently compilable and unit-testable.
acceptance_criteria: FractionalDelay.cpp contains the four Lagrange coefficient expressions exactly as specified for mu in [0,1)
Every read path clamps the final read position to [8 samples, 8.25 * sampleRate samples] via a single shared clamp helper
Buffer memory is allocated only in prepare() and never resized, allocated, or freed in processing functions
Smooth mode implements r = cos(pi*lambda/2)*r_old + sin(pi*lambda/2)*r_new with lambda ramped over a glide time clamped to [5 ms, 1000 ms]
Bend mode implements D[n] = D_start + lambda[n]*(D_target - D_start) and documents p(t) = 1 - dD/dt
reset() zeroes buffer and head state without reallocating
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: include any JUCE header in FractionalDelay.h or FractionalDelay.cpp
create or modify Source/DSP/DelayVoice.*, Source/DSP/FeedbackController.*, or Source/DSP/DelayTimeController.*
allocate, resize, or free memory outside prepare()
use locks, file IO, or string construction in processing functions
